title: OEC Action messages
description: ActionNetworkMessage (ua-action-request, ua-action-response, MG 8.2.16) with ActionRequest (MG 8.2.17) and ActionResponse (MG 8.2.18) and the Payloads of the common service NewDataSetWriterId (MG 8.4.1). Topic-dependent equalities (PublisherId = Responder of the topic, ResponseAddress = Reply topic of the Call topic) and the MessageId suffix = sender are rules of the rule layer.

ActionPublisherId.$comment: REQ-ACT-005 (MG 8.2.16, MG 7.4): <ServiceType>/<IdentificationLink>, structure only; that the PublisherId is the Responder of the topic is a rule of the rule layer

ActionMessageId.$comment: REQ-ACT-004 (MG 8.2.16, SF-049): <unixTimestampInMs>-<PublisherId of the sender>, structure only; that the suffix is the RequestorId (request) or the PublisherId (response) is a rule of the rule layer

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-ACT-003 (MG 8.1.4, MG 8.2.16): CompactEncoding with the fixed content masks; a sender adds no key beyond the guideline, e.g. no DataSetClassId or ReplyTo in the ActionNetworkMessage (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure

allOf.$comment: REQ-ACT-002 (MG 8.2.16): a ua-action-request additionally contains ResponseAddress and TimeoutHint

MessageType.$comment: REQ-ACT-001 (MG 8.2.16, MG 9.2): a Call publishes a ua-action-request

ResponseAddress.$comment: REQ-ACT-006 (MG 8.2.16, MG 9.2, MG 7.4): a Reply topic Oi4v2/<ServiceType>/<AppId>/Reply/<Service>[/<Source>], structure only; that it corresponds to the Call topic is a rule of the rule layer

TimeoutHint.$comment: REQ-ACT-002 (MG 8.2.16): TimeoutHint is a positive Duration in milliseconds

MessageType.$comment: REQ-ACT-001 (MG 8.2.16, MG 9.2): a Reply publishes a ua-action-response

ResponseAddress.$comment: REQ-ACT-002 (MG 8.2.16): a ua-action-response has no ResponseAddress

TimeoutHint.$comment: REQ-ACT-002 (MG 8.2.16): a ua-action-response has no TimeoutHint

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-ACT-003 (MG 8.1.4, MG 8.2.16): CompactEncoding with the fixed content masks; an ActionRequest or ActionResponse has no SequenceNumber, MessageType, PublisherId, DataSetWriterName, WriterGroupName or MinorVersion and no other key beyond the guideline (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure

ActionState.$comment: REQ-ACT-012 (MG 8.2.18, MG 8.2.20): ActionState 1 (Executing, intermediate) or 2 (Done, final) as number

allOf.$comment: REQ-ACT-012 (MG 8.2.18, MG 8.2.20): the Payload of a response with a Bad Status is empty

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-ACT-003 (MG 8.1.4, MG 8.2.16): CompactEncoding with the fixed content masks; an ActionRequest or ActionResponse has no SequenceNumber, MessageType, PublisherId, DataSetWriterName, WriterGroupName or MinorVersion and no other key beyond the guideline (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure

ActionStatus.$comment: REQ-ACT-014 (MG 8.2.3, MG 8.2.18): Status in CompactEncoding: {} for Good, otherwise {"Code": <UInt32>}, never a Symbol

Symbol.$comment: REQ-ACT-014 (MG 8.2.3, MG 8.2.18): the Status of an ActionResponse has no Symbol

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-ACT-003 (MG 8.1.4, MG 8.2.16): the Status has no key beyond Code (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure

NewDataSetWriterIdItem.$comment: ActionRequest or ActionResponse of the common service NewDataSetWriterId (MG 8.4.1)

allOf.$comment: REQ-ACT-019 (MG 8.4, MG 8.2.17): NewDataSetWriterId uses the reserved DataSetWriterId 8
REQ-ACT-019 (MG 8.4, MG 8.2.17): a common service uses ActionTargetId 1

NewDataSetWriterIdRequest.$comment: Payload of a NewDataSetWriterId ActionRequest (MG 8.4.1); the type object is checked by the ActionRequest (REQ-ACT-010)

Resource.$comment: REQ-ACT-013 (MG 8.2.17, SF-035): Resource is a String

allOf.$comment: REQ-ACT-021 (MG 8.4.1): Resource is a ResourceType of MG 7.5.1

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-ACT-013 (MG 8.2.17, MG 8.2.18, SF-035): the Payload has no field beyond the ActionMetaData of the Action (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure

NewDataSetWriterIdResponse.$comment: Payload of a successful NewDataSetWriterId ActionResponse (MG 8.4.1); the type object is checked by the ActionResponse (REQ-ACT-012)

allOf.$comment: REQ-ACT-022 (MG 8.4.1): the response contains DataSetWriterId and Ttl

DataSetWriterId.$comment: REQ-ACT-013 (MG 8.2.18, SF-035): DataSetWriterId is a UInt16

allOf.$comment: REQ-ACT-022 (MG 8.4.1, MG 9.2.1): the provided DataSetWriterId is not reserved (>= 10, REQ-MSG-020)

Ttl.$comment: REQ-ACT-013 (MG 8.2.18, SF-035): Ttl is a UInt32 (seconds)

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-ACT-013 (MG 8.2.17, MG 8.2.18, SF-035): the Payload has no field beyond the ActionMetaData of the Action (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure
